name: Gregory J. Stein
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Multi-Robot Learning-Informed Task Planning (ICRA2026 per lab) combines learned object-location likelihoods with model-based long-horizon coordination. Its planning abstraction connects embodied search, uncertainty and multi-robot decision making.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full2026 primary paper evaluates two physical LoCoBots with RGB cameras/GroundingDINO in two household environments. A neural likelihood model trained in ProcTHOR is reused for real object search, alongside lidar-built static maps. Physical tasks are reaching/searching for objects, not verified physical pick-and-place.

shortVisit.summary: Current faculty/lab sources and summer high-school ASSIP hosting precedent were found, but no external-master’s short-visit invitation. High-school internship history is not an applicable master’s summer pathway.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong embodied learning-informed planning and uncertainty fit.
scoreReasons.physical: Explicit physical two-robot deployments with actual perception and transferred learned likelihoods.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current external master’s visit route; unrelated high-school history not scored.
scoreReasons.freshness: March2026 primary hardware paper and July2026 lab activity.

name: Luyang Zhao
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: A June2026 coauthored study combines learned shape reconstruction and a fine-tuned multimodal LLM with sensorized tensegrity hardware. Current SMILE activities also explore VLA manipulation on SO-101 arms, although the latter is reported as course/research-training work rather than a peer-reviewed policy benchmark.

physicalEvidence.summary: The2026 primary journal study uses a physical six-bar tensegrity structure with24 flexible sensors. LSTM-based shape reconstruction and multimodal LoRA-adapted language modeling support state monitoring and fault diagnosis. This is learned sensing/diagnosis, not demonstrated autonomous learned locomotion or grasping.

shortVisit.summary: Current personal/lab pages welcome prospective students generally, but no explicit current external-master’s eight-week or remote-intern invitation was verified. Third-party recruitment lists are not used to establish such a route.

scoreReasons.fit: Concrete recent multimodal embodied sensing, but narrower than deployed generalist manipulation.
scoreReasons.physical: The physical learned-sensing study retains prior Dartmouth affiliation and international collaboration; current Clemson-local setup is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: General student welcome, no verified short external-master’s invitation.
